Over 60,000 runners participated in the iconic race across the city's five boroughs, braving unseasonably festive conditions that blended race day with lingering Halloween celebrations.

after.story: Sweden's Almgren and Kenya's Chepkirui Win NYC Marathon
after.summary: Sweden's Andreas Almgren captured a surprise victory in the men's race during his debut at the New York City Marathon, while Kenya's Sheila Chepkirui secured her second women's title. Over 60,000 runners participated across the city's five boroughs alongside an estimated 2 million spectators, with Australian Haftu Strintzos finishing fifth to secure an Olympic qualification standard.

note: Australian record-holder Haftu Strintzos finishes fifth, meeting the 2028 Olympic entry standard.

before.story: US Midterm Campaign and Political Debates
before.summary: As the November 3 midterm elections enter their final weekend, Donald Trump and Barack Obama are conducting high-stakes campaign swings across Michigan, Ohio, and Georgia with early voting exceeding 51 million ballots. Simultaneously, federal authorities have launched a criminal investigation in Alaska regarding a spoiler candidate recruited to confuse voters.

after.summary: As the November 3 U.S. midterm elections enter their final weekend with early voting exceeding 51 million ballots, high-profile figures like Donald Trump and Barack Obama execute final campaign swings across battleground states while polling data indicates a seven-to-eight point advantage for Democrats.

note: Early voting surpasses 51 million ballots as final polling shows a Democratic congressional advantage

before.story: French Cost-of-Living Protests Spread to Germany as Halloween Rallies Begin
before.summary: Youth-led cost-of-living demonstrations originating in Seine-Saint-Denis expanded internationally across 34 German cities and French urban hubs, drawing 320,000 marchers on Halloween. As police deployed water cannons, tear gas, and faced petrol bomb attacks resulting in an attempted murder probe, French authorities mobilized 70,000 police officers while Interior Minister Laurent Nuñez enforced strict bans on Halloween masks, following store looting in Frankfurt, over 100 injured German police, and nearly 780 arrests in France.

after.story: French Cost-of-Living Protests Spark Nationwide Riots and German Unrest
after.summary: Youth-led cost-of-living demonstrations originating in Seine-Saint-Denis expanded internationally across 34 German cities and French urban hubs, drawing 320,000 marchers on Halloween; French authorities mobilized 70,000 officers and opened an attempted murder probe after a police officer was set alight by a petrol bomb, while nearly 780 people were arrested in France and over 100 police officers injured in Frankfurt.

note: Paris prosecutors open attempted murder probe after a police officer is set alight by a Molotov cocktail

before.story: Oil Prices Surge Amid Middle East Conflict Escalation
before.summary: Crude benchmarks climbed above $116 a barrel after Houthi drone strikes hit Dammam and naval mine attacks disabled tankers in the Strait of Hormuz, including damage to the Qatari LNG carrier Al Mayeda. With Pentagon conflict replacement costs topping $47.1 billion, Gulf capitals launched multilateral peace talks while OPEC+ signaled steady output quotas.

after.story: Four Tankers Catch Fire in Hormuz Limpet Mine Attacks
after.summary: Crude benchmarks climbed above $116 a barrel after Iranian forces escalated maritime hostilities in the Strait of Hormuz, where four commercial oil tankers suffered explosions from underwater limpet mines—including damage to the Qatari LNG carrier Al Mayeda—prompting Omani search-and-rescue teams to evacuate 25 crew members as regional shipping lanes faced severe disruption.

note: Four commercial tankers catch fire from limpet mines in the Strait of Hormuz, prompting Omani rescues

before.story: EU Unveils New Arctic Strategy
before.summary: The European Union unveiled an updated Arctic security strategy in Brussels, shifting focus from long-term climate targets to immediate geopolitical defense. Led by European Union foreign affairs chief Kaja Kallas, the bloc aims to deploy polar icebreakers, enhance satellite surveillance, establish a maritime security hub, and drop previous hydrocarbon drilling bans.

after.story: EU Unveils Arctic Strategy as UK Deploys Three Nuclear Submarines
after.summary: The European Union unveiled an updated Arctic security strategy in Brussels shifting toward immediate geopolitical defense and satellite surveillance, while the Royal Navy deployed three of its four operational nuclear attack submarines simultaneously on active mission following parliamentary warnings regarding Russian aggression in the High North.

note: Royal Navy deploys three of four nuclear attack submarines simultaneously on active mission

before.story: Global Oil Prices Decline Amid Middle East Diplomacy
before.summary: International crude benchmarks declined toward $114 per barrel as financial markets evaluated fresh diplomatic interventions aimed at averting a renewed U.S. military escalation against Iran. The diplomatic push provided temporary relief to energy markets that had been rattled by potential supply disruptions across the vital Strait of Hormuz maritime corridor.

before.story: Lewis Hamilton Secures Pole Position at Mexico City Grand Prix
before.summary: Ferrari driver Lewis Hamilton clinched his first pole position for Scuderia Ferrari and his first in over three years during qualifying sessions at the Autódromo Hermanos Rodríguez. The performance punctuated a weekend that also saw teammate Charles Leclerc top practice runs and Mercedes driver Kimi Antonelli vie for youngest champion status.

after.story: Kimi Antonelli Wins 2026 F1 World Championship in Mexico
after.summary: Mercedes driver Kimi Antonelli secured the 2026 Formula One world championship at the Mexican Grand Prix after finishing third at the Autódromo Hermanos Rodríguez, becoming the youngest title winner in F1 history at age 20. Earlier in the weekend, Lewis Hamilton clinched his first pole position for Ferrari in over three years, while Red Bull's Max Verstappen won the race.

note: Kimi Antonelli clinches 2026 F1 World Championship; Lewis Hamilton secures pole position.

before.story: Australian Capital City House Prices Post Steepest Quarterly Decline
before.summary: Property market data from Domain shows that house prices across all Australian capital cities fell by 4.7 percent last quarter, marking the steepest drop on record and only the second time prices have fallen simultaneously across every capital. In Melbourne, median house prices are projected to drop below $1 million by the end of the year as prolonged interest rate hikes weigh heavily on the residential property market.

after.story: Australian Capital City House Prices Post Steepest Quarterly Decline
after.summary: Domain property market data shows Australian capital city house prices fell 4.7% last quarter in the steepest drop on record. Westpac expects home values to drop over 10% by March amid elevated interest rates, while Melbourne median house prices are projected below $1 million.

note: Westpac economists project an 11 per cent house price fall while posting a $6.8 billion profit.

before.story: Anthropic Files for IPO After Reporting $114 Billion First-Half Loss
before.summary: AI developer Anthropic moved forward with confidential S-1 paperwork for a Nasdaq initial public offering led by Goldman Sachs and Morgan Stanley, disclosing a $114 billion first-half net loss and $3 billion-a-month customer revenue from SpaceX. However, an intensifying tech stock sell-off fueled by hyperscaler capital expenditure concerns has rattled market sentiment ahead of the landmark listing.

after.story: Anthropic Files for IPO After Reporting $114 Billion First-Half Loss
after.summary: AI developer Anthropic advanced confidential S-1 paperwork for a Nasdaq initial public offering led by Goldman Sachs and Morgan Stanley, aiming to raise up to $3.5 billion in Japan while disclosing a $114 billion first-half net loss and $3 billion-a-month customer revenue from SpaceX.

note: Anthropic aims to raise up to $3.5 billion from Japanese investors in its initial public offering.
